condition: A range that ORs a wildcard `*` with an explicit prerelease alternative (e.g. `* || 1.2.3-alpha`) is collapsed to `*`, so the explicit prerelease version no longer matches when includePrerelease is false.
workaround: Test the prerelease alternative separately (e.g. satisfies(v, '*') || satisfies(v, '1.2.3-alpha')), or pass { includePrerelease: true } if that semantics is acceptable.
